name: Docvet
description: Real-time Python docstring quality diagnostics via LSP. Detects missing Raises, Yields, Attributes, Examples, and cross-reference sections in Google-style docstrings. Also checks for griffe rendering warnings and missing __init__.py files for mkdocs discoverability. Findings appear inline as you code — required rules as warnings, recommended rules as hints.
longDescription:
Ships **61 commands**.

- **Commands** (61): `bmad-agent-bmad-master` (bmad-master agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-analyst` (analyst agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-architect` (architect agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-dev` (dev agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-pm` (pm agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-qa` (qa agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-quick-flow-solo-dev` (quick-flow-solo-dev agent), `bmad-agent-bmm-sm` (sm agent), and 53 more

Installs with `claude plugin install docvet@claude-community` from `Alberto-Codes/docvet`.
